items.title: Message menu floats with an attached caret
items.precondition: A conversation has at least one received and one sent message; the viewport can be tested at desktop and narrow mobile widths.
steps: Reveal a message toolbar and open Message options for both sent and received messages.
Inspect the menu at ordinary placement, then repeat for messages near the thread viewport edges.
Repeat at a narrow mobile width.
items.expected: The menu normally opens directly above a still-visible three-dot action, with a visible bottom-edge notch visibly connected to the menu and pointing straight down at that trigger. When the menu flips or shifts to remain visible, the caret remains on the trigger-facing edge and is never clipped.
items.evidence: 2026-08-08: product owner visually confirmed the menu, bottom notch, and still-visible three-dot trigger in the running app.
items.notes: Automated type/lint/build gates also passed on 2026-08-08.

items.title: Message actions and accessibility remain intact
items.precondition: The same conversation contains a pinnable message and an editable sent text message.
steps: Open Message options with pointer and keyboard.
Activate Pin message (then Unpin message), Edit where allowed, and Unsend where allowed.
Open the menu and dismiss it with Escape and by clicking outside.
items.expected: Existing labels, permissions, callbacks, saving state, keyboard focus, and dismissal behavior are unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-08: product owner confirmed the requested message-menu changes were tested in the running app.
items.notes: Automated type/lint/build gates also passed on 2026-08-08.

items.title: Other dropdown menus retain their existing appearance
items.precondition: The inbox, conversation/thread header, and app navbar are accessible.
steps: Compare their spacing, rounded surface, and lack of caret against the pre-change design.
items.expected: Only message action menus display the new caret; all other dropdowns retain their existing visual treatment and behavior.
items.evidence: 2026-08-08: product owner confirmed the requested message-menu changes were tested in the running app.
items.notes: Automated type/lint/build gates also passed on 2026-08-08.
